instruction_text:
calm, steady news narration with natural emphasis at key points and turns; not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: There was a small twist. A service let people ask AI to make phone calls, but humans were making some calls behind the scenes. This was part of a test. The main service was Muse, Meta's AI assistant. Muse can call businesses and stores in the United States. It can book haircuts, check if items are in stock, and ask for price estimates. If AI can handle difficult phone calls, it seems very useful. But in some tests of its calling feature, trained human contract workers made the calls instead of AI. They spoke with people until each conversation ended.
